info.title: CoinCap API
info.description:
CoinCap gives AI agents, apps, and developers real-time cryptocurrency market data.

Two ways to access:
- **API key** — sign up at https://coincap.io and pass `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `?apiKey=<key>`.
- **Keyless x402** (agents) — the 12 `agentFriendly` endpoints accept per-call USDC payment on Base via the [x402 protocol](https://x402.gitbook.io/x402). No signup needed. See `/.well-known/x402.json` for the machine-readable payment catalog.
info.x-guidance: CoinCap provides real-time and historical cryptocurrency market data. Endpoints under /v3/agentFriendly/* accept keyless per-call payment via the x402 protocol (USDC on Base, eip155:8453): call the endpoint with no auth, read the 402 response for payment terms, sign the EIP-3009 authorization with your wallet, and retry with the signed payload in the Payment-Signature header. All other endpoints require an API key from https://coincap.io passed as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Machine-readable payment catalog: /.well-known/x402.json. Typical flow: GET /v3/agentFriendly/assets_search?search=bitcoin to resolve a slug, then GET /v3/agentFriendly/history/{slug} for price history.

apiKey.name: apiKey
apiKey.description: API key as a query parameter (alternative to the Authorization: Bearer header).

x402.name: Payment-Signature
x402.description: x402 v2 signed payment payload (base64 EIP-3009 authorization). Send no header first to receive a 402 with the price, then retry with the signed payload.

get.summary: Get price history for a SINGLE asset, optimized for AI analysis
get.description: Returns ~200 intelligently sampled price data points in CSV format for any custom time range. 'slug' must be a CoinCap asset slug — resolve it first with /agentFriendly/assets_search. CoinCap slugs differ from other providers: use 'xrp' (not 'ripple'), 'render' (not 'render-token'), 'fetch' (not 'fetch-ai'), 'avalanche' (not 'avalanche-2'). Unknown slugs return HTTP 404. For MULTIPLE assets in one call (comparisons, screening, movers) use /agentFriendly/full_assets_by_slug with slugs=a,b,c and includeHistory=true; for a single current snapshot use /assets/{slug}.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds (defaults to 30 days ago)

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End timestamp in milliseconds (defaults to 1 day ago)

200.description: Historical price data with approximately 200 data points

400.description: Bad request - missing or invalid parameters

404.description: Asset not found or no history data available

get.summary: Get comprehensive data for one OR MANY assets in a single call
get.description: Get comprehensive data for one OR MANY assets in a single call (comma-separated slugs, max 10). PREFER THIS over repeated single-asset history calls for comparison and screening tasks; set includeHistory=true for performance windows (5min/24h, daily/30d, weekly/365d) and includeTaData=true for indicators. Returns price, market data, technical analysis, token addresses, and news with selective field inclusion.

parameters.name: includeHistory
parameters.description: Include historical price data (5min/24h, daily/30d, weekly/365d)

last24Hours.description: CSV format data "timestamp,price" (5-minute intervals for past day)

last30Days.description: CSV format data "timestamp,price" (daily intervals for past 30 days)

last365Days.description: CSV format data "timestamp,price" (weekly intervals for past year)

get.summary: Candlestick (OHLC) data for MULTIPLE assets in one call
get.description: Returns OHLC candlestick data (no volume — the underlying history source is price-only) for up to 10 CoinCap slugs in a single call — use this instead of looping per-asset candlestick calls for comparison and screening tasks. Per-slug failures (e.g. an unknown slug) are returned in-band as { slug, ok: false, error } entries rather than failing the whole request. Resolve slugs with /agentFriendly/assets_search before calling. One batch call consumes a single token from the shared TA rate pool (15 calls / 15s), regardless of how many slugs are requested. Each asset's candles are capped at 30 days of underlying history per call — coarse intervals return fewer candles than requested once that cap is hit (e.g. interval=d1 returns at most ~30 candles even if limit is higher). Duplicate slugs are deduplicated. If the slug list had to be cut down to 10, the requested limit had to be clamped to 200, or the 30-day history cap reduced the number of candles returned, the response includes a top-level "truncated": true flag (omitted when nothing was truncated).

parameters.name: slugs
parameters.description: Comma-separated CoinCap asset slugs (deduplicated, max 10, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum)

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Candle timeframe, shared across all requested slugs

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of most recent candles to return per asset (max 200). Actual history fetched per asset is also capped at 30 days, so a large limit with a coarse interval (e.g. d1) may return fewer candles than requested.

truncated.description: Present and true when the slug list was cut down to 10, the requested limit was clamped to 200, or the 30-day history cap reduced the number of candles returned for an interval/limit combination; omitted otherwise.

post.summary: Create a free prepaid API key
post.description:
Creates a new prepaid API key with 50 free starter credits. No payment or signup required.
When credits run out, the API will return 402 with instructions to refill via /prepaid/refill.

post.summary: Refill a prepaid API key (x402 payment)
post.description:
Adds credits to an existing prepaid API key via x402 USDC payment on Base.

**Flow:**
1. POST with just `apiKey` in body (no PAYMENT header) → returns 402 with payment instructions
2. Sign an EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` using EIP-712 typed data with domain `{name: "USD Coin", version: "2", chainId: 8453, verifyingContract: "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913"}`
3. Base64-encode the JSON payload `{from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce, v, r, s}` and retry with `PAYMENT` header

500 credits per $1 USDC. Minimum payment: $0.01 USDC.

parameters.name: PAYMENT
parameters.description:
Base64-encoded JSON with EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization signature.
Shape: { from: address, to: address, value: string (USDC smallest units, 6 decimals), validAfter: number, validBefore: number, nonce: bytes32, v: number, r: bytes32, s: bytes32 }

apiKey.description: The prepaid API key to refill

402.description: Payment required. Response includes full x402 payment instructions.

payTo.description: USDC recipient address — use as the `to` field when signing transferWithAuthorization (the server wallet only submits the tx and pays gas)

amountRequired.description: Amount in smallest USDC units (6 decimals)

payloadFormat.description: Expected flat JSON shape for the PAYMENT header (base64-encoded)
payloadFormat.example: { from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce, v, r, s }

get.description: Returns credit balance, usage, and remaining credits for a prepaid API key. No payment or authentication required.

tags.name: Price
tags.description: Minimal endpoints to fetch a USD price by address+network or by symbol.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: The asset price is a volume-weighted average calculated by collecting ticker data from exchanges. Each exchange contributes to this price in relation to their volume. All values are translated into USD and can be converted through the /rates endpoint.

tags.name: Exchanges
tags.description: The /exchanges endpoint offers an understanding into where cryptocurrency is being exchanged and provides high-level information on those exchanges. CoinCap strives to provide transparency in the recency of our exchange data. For that purpose, you will find an "updated" key for each exchange. For more details into coin pairs and volume, see the /markets endpoint.

tags.name: Markets
tags.description: Take a closer look into exchanges with the /markets endpoint. Similar to the /exchanges endpoint, we strive to offer transparency into how real-time our data is with a key identifying when the market was last updated. For a historical view on how a market has performed, see the /candles endpoint.

tags.name: Rates
tags.description: All prices on the CoinCap API are standardized in USD (United States Dollar). To make translating to other values easy, CoinCap offers a Rates endpoint with fiat and top cryptocurrency translated rates. Fiat rates are available through OpenExchangeRates.org.

tags.name: Technical Analysis
tags.description: TA related endpoints for retrieving technical indicators and derived candlestick data.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Returns wallet address, tier information, staked balances, available API keys, reward rates, and more. Staked balances are in terms of Morpheos Tokens (MOR) on either base or arbitrum chains.

tags.name: AgentFriendly (Beta)
tags.description:
Experimental agent optimized endpoints for use by our chatbot and others.
- Limits data points per response for optimal processing
- Simplified JSON structures with clear field names

** These endpoints are under development and may change without notice. Use at your own risk. **

tags.name: Prepaid
tags.description: Accountless prepaid API keys via x402 USDC payments on Base. No signup required — pay with USDC to create or refill a key.
